scope: Independent local text, byte/hash, AST and call-shape review only. No target modules, parser, auditor, workload, builder entry point or host operations were executed by this review.

real_finding_and_correction.finding: closed_matrix groups store a cell's raw_timing object as interval. The initial D2 bridge passed that interval directly to the original measured_counter helper, which expects a whole cell and indexes cell['raw_timing']. This would fail during postmatrix interpretation.
real_finding_and_correction.correction: The call site now passes {'raw_timing': cells[0]} to the unchanged helper. The original timing object and numeric computation are unchanged.

findings.conclusion: SPEC is None. require_sealed is invoked before loading original helper modules, creating the evidence directory or launching the original wrapper. Its only changes from D1 are the explicit D2 namespace.

EnvironmentBinding and closed_matrix are byte-identical to the frozen D1 template. Main reconstructs exactly after reversing only the new boot record, postmatrix helper load/interpretation/coverage block and namespace. Original wrapper argv retains the same feature ELF for A and B, ABBA modes off/on/on/off, C1, 192 measured, 24 warmup, two workers, six preflight and twelve restart calls per round.

Original Controller.__init__, close, cell, save_report and direct Popen identities remain checked. No new Popen wrapper, reaper, FD-exec mechanism or workload cancellation hook is introduced. The environment hook is restored in its existing finally paths and frame references are released.

No trace is read until the original complete matrix returns successfully and closed_matrix verifies all eight normal controller closes. On workload, warmup, exception or close failure, the adapter preserves its original failure/report behavior and does not claim successful trace interpretation. The original constructor partial-owner limitation remains an outer ownership responsibility.

All ten correlation helper function bodies are byte-exact copies of the completed D1 offline interpreter pinned by SHA256 7857a1f8960e82cbb1ba7700c1e805b87f7363cf5d8c3fecf32c5ebbf0dfa870. Only module imports/constants and namespace are newly supplied. The module itself has no process launch, host client, extraction or native-auditor call.

The bridge first reads the original raw transport and index through the retained bounded stable regular-file reader and compares them with shutdown capture identities. Copied helpers require contiguous indexed complete frames, canonical request and response hashes, unique JSON-RPC/frame use and original ordered RPC/call/cell intervals. Reader read_start is not treated as the lower RPC bound.

The trace header must match the original controller mode, PID, birth ticks, persisted current-campaign boot and qualified feature ELF. Its start/end bounds remain inside the original controller lifetime. Each ON whole request span must match exactly one original same-host/same-operation RPC and every original call must match exactly one trace request. Matrix-wide native IDs must be unique across 468 selected ON requests, with 384 measured requests.

The copied transport checker verifies that status/read responses do not expose the request-v8 marker. It records wire_native_request_id as null; the actual internal identity comes from the bound trace. It never presents a synthesized wire ID or assumes the failed D1 public-ID contract.

The parser validates each entire trace before any selection. The reused selective arithmetic must exactly reproduce all parser phase distributions, every request CPU total and whole-trace recorded CPU total. Preflight/warmup/measured/restart groups are separate; only the 384 measured ON requests enter the combined measured phase summary. OFF absence is not reported as zero work CPU.

The adapter explicitly names ValidationOwner/ValidationWorker inclusive CPU as the whole-validation values. Their exclusive values are only the residual after direct synchronous children. Whole read-loop labels include original reads, cancellation checks and comparison/hash update; nested wall sums are nonadditive. Controller-minus-recorded residuals retain their sign and are not assigned to remote/network CPU.

The unchanged main catches interpretation failure, retains raw outputs and writes an analysis_complete=false report, returning failure. The adapter does not execute the native auditor and still requires the parent to run the original auditor and close held-agent, quiet90, compiler-monitor and source/ELF custody. This review does not substitute for those future receipts.

frozen_parser_pending.requirement: Before actual source sealing, replace the clearly declared D1 parser placeholder with the exact D2 parser and bind correlation plus parser in the parent/source/installation inventory.
